Language has two options, at bottom. Resolve upon the "It" and merge one’s self into the existential Being of the Universe, or resolve upon the "I" and swallow up the universe in the existential Being of the Atman. Neither suffices to relay the truth of infinite Being, which is neither resolved nor unresolved. Even a middling term such as "suchness" is a compromise, a position for the positionless in the undulating mirror of its immovability.
